name: e2b-dev/e2b-cookbook
title: E2B cookbook adds Hatchet jobs and Anchor Browser
summary: New E2B cookbook examples pair sandboxes with Hatchet, so each agent step runs in its own sandbox with scheduling, retries, and recovery, and with Anchor Browser for signed-in cloud browsing. A Hatchet task can kill a sandbox and reconnect with its files still there, and the browser stays outside the sandbox.
